hebrewText: וַ/יָּ֗שָׁב וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֛ח שַׂר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שְׁלִשִׁ֖ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑י/ו וַ/יַּ֡עַל וַ/יָּבֹא֩ שַׂר הַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֜י וַ/יִּכְרַ֥ע עַל בִּרְכָּ֣י/ו לְ/נֶ֣גֶד אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יִּתְחַנֵּ֤ן אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו אִ֚ישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים תִּֽיקַר נָ֣א נַפְשִׁ֗/י וְ/נֶ֨פֶשׁ עֲבָדֶ֥י/ךָֽ אֵ֛לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ

tokens.bdb: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
tokens.kjv: ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) [idiom] again, (cause to) answer ([phrase] again), [idiom] in any case (wise), [idiom] at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, [idiom] certainly, come again (back), [idiom] consider, [phrase] continually, convert, deliver (again), [phrase] deny, draw back, fetch home again, [idiom] fro, get (oneself) (back) again, [idiom] give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, [idiom] needs, be past, [idiom] pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, [phrase] say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, [idiom] surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

tokens.bdb: a head person (of any rank or class)
tokens.kjv: captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

tokens.bdb: fifty
tokens.kjv: fifty.

tokens.bdb: third; feminine athird (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell)
tokens.kjv: third (part, rank, time), three (years old).

tokens.bdb: fifty
tokens.kjv: fifty.

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: a head person (of any rank or class)
tokens.kjv: captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

tokens.bdb: fifty
tokens.kjv: fifty.

tokens.bdb: third; feminine athird (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell)
tokens.kjv: third (part, rank, time), three (years old).

tokens.bdb: to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate
tokens.kjv: bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, [idiom] very.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to bend the knee; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to bend the knee; by implication
tokens.explanation: to bend the knee; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to bend the knee; by implication

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: a knee
tokens.kjv: knee.

tokens.bdb: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
tokens.kjv: about, (over) against, [idiom] aloof, [idiom] far (off), [idiom] from, over, presence, [idiom] other side, sight, [idiom] to view.

tokens.bdb: Elijah, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites
tokens.kjv: Elijah, Eliah.

tokens.bdb: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
tokens.kjv: beseech, [idiom] fair, (be, find, shew) favour(-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious(-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit)
tokens.kjv: be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.

tokens.bdb: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
tokens.kjv: I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.

tokens.bdb: a servant
tokens.kjv: [idiom] bondage, bondman, (bond-) servant, (man-) servant.

tokens.bdb: these or those
tokens.kjv: an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).

tokens.bdb: fifty
tokens.kjv: fifty.

tokens.bdb: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).
